title: Largest Group of Strangers
statement:
In a group of `n` people some pairs know each other. Pick as many people as possible so that no two picked people know each other.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `m`. Each of the next `m` lines contains two people (numbered from 1) who know each other. No pair is listed twice.

## Output
Print the largest possible number of picked people.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 20`
- `0 <= m <= n(n-1)/2`
